title: 鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類~Core logging and rock-mass classification
focus: 從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界~Derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness
summary: 本課聚焦從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 回次與深度閉合~Runs and depth closure
units.title: 回次與深度閉合~Runs and depth closure
units.mechanism: 岩心箱的順序建立地下空間的索引，鑽進回次與回收長度不閉合時，後續試驗再精準也會失去位置。接桿量測、殘留岩心與鑽具長度須分開記錄，不能把深度誤差藏入某個破碎段。 假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。 把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。~Core-box order indexes subsurface space. If advance and recovery do not close, even precise tests lose their location. Record rod measurements, retained core and tooling lengths separately instead of hiding a depth discrepancy inside a broken interval. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique. Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique.
units.verify: 核對鑽班原始進尺、岩心箱分隔牌與完整照片，重新量測岩心長度；深度無法閉合的回次需標出不確定區間，待記錄者與地質師共同釐清，不能默默移動標牌。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。~Reconcile original drilling advance, run dividers and complete photographs and remeasure recovered length; mark unresolved intervals for joint review by the logger and geologist rather than silently moving a divider. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths.
units.failure: 把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。~Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths.
units.misconception: 岩心缺失的深度可以任意放在該回次最底部。~Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄回次與深度閉合的資料來源與適用條件。核對鑽班原始進尺、岩心箱分隔牌與完整照片，重新量測岩心長度；深度無法閉合的回次需標出不確定區間，待記錄者與地質師共同釐清，不能默默移動標牌。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for runs and depth closure. Reconcile original drilling advance, run dividers and complete photographs and remeasure recovered length; mark unresolved intervals for joint review by the logger and geologist rather than silently moving a divider.

units.anchor: 岩石品質指標~Rock quality designation
units.title: 岩石品質指標~Rock quality designation
units.mechanism: RQD只計符合長度條件的健全岩心，機械折斷應辨識並重接；它反映沿孔方向的塊體分割，而不是完整三維岩體強度。與孔平行的節理很少被截交，方向偏差必須保留。 假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。 把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。~RQD counts sound pieces meeting a length criterion, with recognized mechanical breaks reassembled. It describes segmentation along the hole rather than three-dimensional mass strength. Joints parallel to the hole are undersampled, so directional bias remains. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%. Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%.
units.verify: 用端面吻合與新鮮破面區分機械斷裂，逐段保留計入長度及照片；另一位記錄者獨立複核臨界長度岩心，再對照孔方向與節理組，確認分類未忽略取樣方向。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。~Distinguish mechanical breaks using matching fresh ends and retain counted lengths and photographs; a second logger checks borderline pieces, then compares hole orientation with joint sets to expose directional sampling bias. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone.
units.failure: 把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。~Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone.
units.misconception: 岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。~High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄岩石品質指標的資料來源與適用條件。用端面吻合與新鮮破面區分機械斷裂，逐段保留計入長度及照片；另一位記錄者獨立複核臨界長度岩心，再對照孔方向與節理組，確認分類未忽略取樣方向。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rock quality designation. Distinguish mechanical breaks using matching fresh ends and retain counted lengths and photographs; a second logger checks borderline pieces, then compares hole orientation with joint sets to expose directional sampling bias.

units.anchor: 節理間距方向~Directional joint spacing
units.title: 節理間距方向~Directional joint spacing
units.mechanism: 掃描線截交頻率取決於節理法線和測線夾角；同一岩體由不同方向鑽孔會得到不同表觀間距。幾何修正接近平行時變得不穩定，應報告不可辨識的組別而非無限放大權重。 假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。 忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。~Intersection frequency depends on the angle between joint normal and survey line. Different hole directions produce different apparent spacing. Corrections become unstable near parallel orientation, requiring an unresolved-set warning rather than unbounded weighting. Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m. Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m.
units.verify: 將孔軸與節理極點畫在同一球面投影，查核取向資料的定向基準；以不同方向孔或露頭掃描線交叉驗證，接近平行且樣本稀少的組別須在報告中明示下限或缺口。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。~Plot hole axes and joint poles on the same stereonet and verify orientation datum; cross-check differently directed holes or exposure scanlines and state bounds or gaps for nearly parallel, sparsely sampled sets. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics.
units.failure: 忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。~Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics.
units.misconception: 不同方向鑽孔的表觀節理間距可以不修正直接比較。~Apparent joint spacing from differently oriented holes can be compared without correction.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄節理間距方向的資料來源與適用條件。將孔軸與節理極點畫在同一球面投影，查核取向資料的定向基準；以不同方向孔或露頭掃描線交叉驗證，接近平行且樣本稀少的組別須在報告中明示下限或缺口。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for directional joint spacing. Plot hole axes and joint poles on the same stereonet and verify orientation datum; cross-check differently directed holes or exposure scanlines and state bounds or gaps for nearly parallel, sparsely sampled sets.

units.anchor: 節理表面與充填~Joint surfaces and infill
units.title: 節理表面與充填~Joint surfaces and infill
units.mechanism: 節理粗糙度、風化與充填共同決定剪力機制，兩個表面是否接觸比單看顏色重要。厚軟填土可隔開岩壁粗糙峰，於是完整岩石強度再高也不能代表節理面的抗剪能力。 假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。 洗去黏土後記錄的粗糙岩壁會誇大現地摩擦力，乾燥樣品也可能掩蓋遇水軟化；看似良好節理在開挖卸荷與滲水後仍可能滑動。~Roughness, weathering and infill jointly govern joint shear. Contact between opposing walls matters more than color. Thick weak infill can separate rough rock asperities, making intact rock strength irrelevant to the shearing plane. For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor. Washing clay away exaggerates the friction represented by rough walls, while dry samples conceal water softening. An apparently favorable joint can still slide after excavation unloading and seepage.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor.
units.verify: 以比例照片、觸感及樣品描述保存填料厚度和連續性，避免清洗後才記錄；同時比較飽和狀態及相同法向應力的剪力試驗，只有一致的材料與邊界條件才可互相比對。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：洗去黏土後記錄的粗糙岩壁會誇大現地摩擦力，乾燥樣品也可能掩蓋遇水軟化；看似良好節理在開挖卸荷與滲水後仍可能滑動。~Preserve scaled photographs and samples of infill thickness and continuity before washing; compare saturation and shear tests at matching normal stress, accepting comparisons only for consistent material and boundary conditions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Washing clay away exaggerates the friction represented by rough walls, while dry samples conceal water softening. An apparently favorable joint can still slide after excavation unloading and seepage.
units.failure: 洗去黏土後記錄的粗糙岩壁會誇大現地摩擦力，乾燥樣品也可能掩蓋遇水軟化；看似良好節理在開挖卸荷與滲水後仍可能滑動。~Washing clay away exaggerates the friction represented by rough walls, while dry samples conceal water softening. An apparently favorable joint can still slide after excavation unloading and seepage.
units.misconception: 洗乾淨的節理岩壁足以代表原位含填料剪切行為。~Cleaned joint walls adequately represent the original infilled joint's shear behavior.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄節理表面與充填的資料來源與適用條件。以比例照片、觸感及樣品描述保存填料厚度和連續性，避免清洗後才記錄；同時比較飽和狀態及相同法向應力的剪力試驗，只有一致的材料與邊界條件才可互相比對。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint surfaces and infill. Preserve scaled photographs and samples of infill thickness and continuity before washing; compare saturation and shear tests at matching normal stress, accepting comparisons only for consistent material and boundary conditions.

units.anchor: 單軸強度與取樣~Uniaxial strength and sampling
units.title: 單軸強度與取樣~Uniaxial strength and sampling
units.mechanism: 單軸壓縮是完整岩石試件的強度，不包含大尺度節理。端面平整、長徑比與含水狀態影響破壞模式，若只挑完整段製樣，得到的分布會系統性排除最差地層。 假設直徑50 mm試體破壞荷重200 kN，σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa；不等於岩體強度。 端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。~Uniaxial compression measures intact specimen strength, excluding large joints. End preparation, slenderness and moisture influence failure. Selecting only pieces convenient for preparation systematically removes the weakest ground from the resulting distribution. An assumed 50 mm diameter specimen failing at 200 kN gives σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa; this is not rock-mass strength. End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength. Applying that mean to the mass hides weak surfaces controlling deformation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直徑50 mm試體破壞荷重200 kN，σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa；不等於岩體強度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 50 mm diameter specimen failing at 200 kN gives σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa; this is not rock-mass strength.
units.verify: 量測直徑與端面條件，拍攝破壞型態並追溯樣品孔號深度；把無法製樣的軟弱段另列，採相應試驗補足代表性，試驗主管依適用方法確認數據能否比較。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。~Measure diameter and end condition, photograph failure and trace hole-depth identity; list weak intervals that could not be prepared and investigate them appropriately, with the laboratory lead confirming method-compatible comparisons. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength. Applying that mean to the mass hides weak surfaces controlling deformation.
units.failure: 端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。~End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength. Applying that mean to the mass hides weak surfaces controlling deformation.
units.misconception: 完整岩心抗壓強度就是含節理岩體的設計強度。~Intact-core compressive strength is the design strength of the jointed rock mass.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄單軸強度與取樣的資料來源與適用條件。量測直徑與端面條件，拍攝破壞型態並追溯樣品孔號深度；把無法製樣的軟弱段另列，採相應試驗補足代表性，試驗主管依適用方法確認數據能否比較。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for uniaxial strength and sampling. Measure diameter and end condition, photograph failure and trace hole-depth identity; list weak intervals that could not be prepared and investigate them appropriately, with the laboratory lead confirming method-compatible comparisons.

units.anchor: 分類分項透明~Transparent classification components
units.title: 分類分項透明~Transparent classification components
units.mechanism: 分類系統把多種觀測壓縮成工程指標，總分相同並不意味相同失效機制。強度佳但節理不利與強度弱但塊狀完整可能得到相似分數，設計必須保留各分項及地下水情境。 假設六個示範評分為12、15、10、20、7、−5，合計59；此加總練習不聲稱對應某版分類門檻。 把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。~Classification compresses observations into an index, but equal totals need not mean equal mechanisms. Strong rock with adverse joints can resemble weak but massive rock numerically, so component ratings and groundwater scenarios must remain visible. Assumed illustrative component scores of 12,15,10,20,7 and −5 total 59; this arithmetic exercise does not claim a threshold in a particular classification edition. Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness. Equal totals can then assign identical support to different mechanisms, overlooking wedge instability or squeezing ground.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設六個示範評分為12、15、10、20、7、−5，合計59；此加總練習不聲稱對應某版分類門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed illustrative component scores of 12,15,10,20,7 and −5 total 59; this arithmetic exercise does not claim a threshold in a particular classification edition.
units.verify: 保存每一分項的原始依據、評分表版本及評分者，對地下水或取向做敏感度比較；以實際出露和變形驗證推薦支護的適用性，總分僅作索引而非自動施工指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。~Retain evidence, rating-table edition and assessor for every component and test water and orientation sensitivity; verify support applicability against exposures and movement, using the total as an index rather than an automatic construction instruction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness. Equal totals can then assign identical support to different mechanisms, overlooking wedge instability or squeezing ground.
units.failure: 把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。~Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness. Equal totals can then assign identical support to different mechanisms, overlooking wedge instability or squeezing ground.
units.misconception: 岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。~Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄分類分項透明的資料來源與適用條件。保存每一分項的原始依據、評分表版本及評分者，對地下水或取向做敏感度比較；以實際出露和變形驗證推薦支護的適用性，總分僅作索引而非自動施工指令。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for transparent classification components. Retain evidence, rating-table edition and assessor for every component and test water and orientation sensitivity; verify support applicability against exposures and movement, using the total as an index rather than an automatic construction instruction.

units.anchor: 乘法指標敏感~Multiplicative index sensitivity
units.title: 乘法指標敏感~Multiplicative index sensitivity
units.mechanism: 乘法形式的岩體指標對分母與低值項特別敏感，輸入稍有改動即可跨越多個等級。這種指標是經驗模型，必須使用同一版本定義，不能把不同方法中同名因子混在一起。 假設Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889；若Jw由1降為0.5，其餘不變，Q=0.444。 把地下水因子視為永久不變會忽略季節或開挖導水，錯誤分母又可使指標偏差數倍；輸出小數位再多也不能補足取樣與判讀不足。~Multiplicative rock indices are sensitive to denominators and small factors, so modest input changes may cross several classes. These empirical models require consistent edition-specific definitions; similarly named factors from different systems are not interchangeable. For assumed Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889, reducing Jw from 1 to 0.5 while holding other factors fixed gives Q=0.444. Treating water factors as permanent ignores seasonal or excavation-induced changes; an incorrect denominator shifts the index severalfold, and extra decimal places do not cure deficient sampling or interpretation.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889；若Jw由1降為0.5，其餘不變，Q=0.444。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889, reducing Jw from 1 to 0.5 while holding other factors fixed gives Q=0.444.
units.verify: 由原始節理組數、粗糙狀況、水情與應力描述追查各比值，另以合理上下限重算；若輸入只是假設，結果不得轉成精確支護間距，需由岩工工程師結合失效分析審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把地下水因子視為永久不變會忽略季節或開挖導水，錯誤分母又可使指標偏差數倍；輸出小數位再多也不能補足取樣與判讀不足。~Trace each ratio to joint-set count, surface condition, water and stress descriptions and recalculate plausible bounds; assumed inputs must not become precise support spacing without rock-engineering review of failure mechanisms. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating water factors as permanent ignores seasonal or excavation-induced changes; an incorrect denominator shifts the index severalfold, and extra decimal places do not cure deficient sampling or interpretation.
units.failure: 把地下水因子視為永久不變會忽略季節或開挖導水，錯誤分母又可使指標偏差數倍；輸出小數位再多也不能補足取樣與判讀不足。~Treating water factors as permanent ignores seasonal or excavation-induced changes; an incorrect denominator shifts the index severalfold, and extra decimal places do not cure deficient sampling or interpretation.
units.misconception: 乘法岩體指標中的地下水因子永遠不會隨施工改變。~The water factor in a multiplicative rock index never changes during construction.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄乘法指標敏感的資料來源與適用條件。由原始節理組數、粗糙狀況、水情與應力描述追查各比值，另以合理上下限重算；若輸入只是假設，結果不得轉成精確支護間距，需由岩工工程師結合失效分析審查。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for multiplicative index sensitivity. Trace each ratio to joint-set count, surface condition, water and stress descriptions and recalculate plausible bounds; assumed inputs must not become precise support spacing without rock-engineering review of failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 尺度與代表體積~Scale and representative volume
units.title: 尺度與代表體積~Scale and representative volume
units.mechanism: 小岩心可能完全避開長而連續的節理，卻又把局部碎裂段過度放大。從厘米試件到隧道尺度需要描述結構面的持續性、間距與連通，不能只把試體尺寸比例套在強度上。 假設隧道直徑10 m、岩心直徑0.05 m，尺度比200；截面面積比200²=40000，不能據此直接縮減強度。 過度依賴完整小樣會低估大塊體滑落，單一破碎回次又可能使整段支護過度保守；兩種偏差都來自把局部觀測誤當代表體積。~Small cores may miss persistent joints while overemphasizing one crushed interval. Moving from centimetre specimens to tunnel scale requires persistence, spacing and connectivity, not a strength correction based solely on specimen dimensions. For assumed tunnel diameter 10 m and core diameter 0.05 m, length ratio is 200 and area ratio 40000; neither directly determines a strength reduction. Reliance on intact small samples underestimates large-block movement, whereas one crushed run may overstate support demand along a long reach; both mistakes confuse local evidence with a representative volume.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設隧道直徑10 m、岩心直徑0.05 m，尺度比200；截面面積比200²=40000，不能據此直接縮減強度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed tunnel diameter 10 m and core diameter 0.05 m, length ratio is 200 and area ratio 40000; neither directly determines a strength reduction.
units.verify: 將岩心、露頭與掌子面節理圖放在共同坐標中，查核長節理是否延續及樣本是否覆蓋主要岩性；統計不收斂時須增補資料或給區間，不能以增加同一小區域樣本假裝提高全場代表性。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：過度依賴完整小樣會低估大塊體滑落，單一破碎回次又可能使整段支護過度保守；兩種偏差都來自把局部觀測誤當代表體積。~Integrate core, exposure and face-joint maps in one coordinate system, checking persistence and lithological coverage; nonconvergent statistics require added evidence or intervals, not merely more samples from the same small area. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reliance on intact small samples underestimates large-block movement, whereas one crushed run may overstate support demand along a long reach; both mistakes confuse local evidence with a representative volume.
units.failure: 過度依賴完整小樣會低估大塊體滑落，單一破碎回次又可能使整段支護過度保守；兩種偏差都來自把局部觀測誤當代表體積。~Reliance on intact small samples underestimates large-block movement, whereas one crushed run may overstate support demand along a long reach; both mistakes confuse local evidence with a representative volume.
units.misconception: 岩心與隧道的尺寸比可直接當成強度折減係數。~The core-to-tunnel size ratio directly supplies the required strength-reduction factor.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄尺度與代表體積的資料來源與適用條件。將岩心、露頭與掌子面節理圖放在共同坐標中，查核長節理是否延續及樣本是否覆蓋主要岩性；統計不收斂時須增補資料或給區間，不能以增加同一小區域樣本假裝提高全場代表性。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for scale and representative volume. Integrate core, exposure and face-joint maps in one coordinate system, checking persistence and lithological coverage; nonconvergent statistics require added evidence or intervals, not merely more samples from the same small area.

units.anchor: 記錄者差異控制~Controlling logger differences
units.title: 記錄者差異控制~Controlling logger differences
units.mechanism: 岩心描述含觀察與判斷，顏色、風化與節理條件的用語須有共同基準。雙人記錄不是取平均即可，分歧若集中於某一因子，應先找照明、樣品狀態或定義差異。 假設20段中兩位記錄者有16段分類一致，原始一致率80%；它未扣除偶然一致，不能等同Kappa。 不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。~Core logging combines observation and judgment. Color, weathering and joint condition need common definitions. Independent logs should not simply be averaged; concentrated disagreement points to lighting, sample state or inconsistent definitions requiring review. If two loggers agree on 16 of an assumed 20 intervals, raw agreement is 80%; without chance correction this is not a kappa statistic. Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設20段中兩位記錄者有16段分類一致，原始一致率80%；它未扣除偶然一致，不能等同Kappa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If two loggers agree on 16 of an assumed 20 intervals, raw agreement is 80%; without chance correction this is not a kappa statistic.
units.verify: 以盲重記固定比例岩心，交叉比較分項而非只比總分；用保留的照片和樣品討論分歧並記錄裁定依據，若方法改版則保留舊版，避免悄悄改寫原始觀察。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。~Blindly relog a fixed sample and compare components rather than totals; resolve discrepancies using retained images and specimens and document the basis, preserving earlier versions when methods change instead of rewriting original observations. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice.
units.failure: 不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。~Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice.
units.misconception: 兩位記錄者有分歧時，把總分平均就能消除偏差。~Averaging two disagreeing loggers' total scores removes the underlying bias.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄記錄者差異控制的資料來源與適用條件。以盲重記固定比例岩心，交叉比較分項而非只比總分；用保留的照片和樣品討論分歧並記錄裁定依據，若方法改版則保留舊版，避免悄悄改寫原始觀察。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for controlling logger differences. Blindly relog a fixed sample and compare components rather than totals; resolve discrepancies using retained images and specimens and document the basis, preserving earlier versions when methods change instead of rewriting original observations.

units.title: 分類到模型交接~Classification-to-model handover
units.mechanism: 岩體分類提供經驗參考，數值模型還需要應力、構造與水文邊界。交接應列明哪些參數來自試驗、哪些來自關聯式，並說明不利節理是否顯式建模，避免同一弱化作用被重複計入。 假設10個設計參數中6個實測、4個推估，推估比例40%；這是證據組成而非模型失敗機率。 若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。~Classification supplies empirical context while analysis also requires stress, structure and hydraulic boundaries. Handover distinguishes tested and correlated parameters and explicit joints, preventing the same weakening effect from being counted twice. If 6 of an assumed 10 design parameters are measured and 4 inferred, the inferred fraction is 40%; this describes evidence composition, not model failure probability. Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10個設計參數中6個實測、4個推估，推估比例40%；這是證據組成而非模型失敗機率。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 6 of an assumed 10 design parameters are measured and 4 inferred, the inferred fraction is 40%; this describes evidence composition, not model failure probability.
units.verify: 從設計參數表抽查至岩心箱、試驗單與分類公式，檢查單位、版本和尺度；針對推估參數安排敏感度包絡，只有主管工程師確認主控失效機制與資料相符後才釋出分析結論。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。~Trace model parameters to core boxes, test sheets and classification equations, checking units, edition and scale; bracket inferred values in sensitivity analysis and release conclusions only after engineering review of governing failure mechanisms. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction.
units.failure: 若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。~Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction.
units.misconception: 折減整體模數後再加同一節理弱化不會重複計算。~Reducing bulk stiffness and adding the same joint weakening cannot double-count damage.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄分類到模型交接的資料來源與適用條件。從設計參數表抽查至岩心箱、試驗單與分類公式，檢查單位、版本和尺度；針對推估參數安排敏感度包絡，只有主管工程師確認主控失效機制與資料相符後才釋出分析結論。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for classification-to-model handover. Trace model parameters to core boxes, test sheets and classification equations, checking units, edition and scale; bracket inferred values in sensitivity analysis and release conclusions only after engineering review of governing failure mechanisms.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique.
教學量化備忘：假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。~Teaching quantitative note: If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%.
教學量化備忘：假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m.

教學量化備忘：假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor.

教學量化備忘：假設直徑50 mm試體破壞荷重200 kN，σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa；不等於岩體強度。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 50 mm diameter specimen failing at 200 kN gives σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa; this is not rock-mass strength.

教學量化備忘：假設六個示範評分為12、15、10、20、7、−5，合計59；此加總練習不聲稱對應某版分類門檻。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed illustrative component scores of 12,15,10,20,7 and −5 total 59; this arithmetic exercise does not claim a threshold in a particular classification edition.
